data.title: Joseph Awuah-Darko
data.extract: Joseph Nanana Kwame Awoah Darko, also known as Ocuntakinte, is a Ghanaian artist, and social media personality. He started a music career professionally in late 2015 He has also founded several African art initiatives and faced a lawsuit in connection with these projects. In 2024, he announced via Instagram his intention to pursue assisted euthanasia in the Netherlands, citing his bipolar disorder, and launched his Last Supper Project, asking to have dinner with friends and strangers to celebrate human connection as he counted down to the end of his life. In July of 2025, he started to hint on Instagram that he no longer plans on pursuing assisted euthanasia. He now posts as an advocate as an SA survivor with a new outlook on life following the Last Supper Project.
